text: The Senior Strategic Policy Consultant, Housing Secretariat and the Project Director, Corporate Initiatives, Governance and Corporate Strategy, City Manager's Office, will provide an overview of the City's HousingTO 2020-2030 Action Plan, the City's progress in implementation to-date and key implementation priorities for 2022. The HousingTO Plan, which includes an updated Housing Charter, provides a blueprint for action across the full housing spectrum - from homelessness to rental and ownership housing to long-term care for seniors.
The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee received the item for information.
